Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Specific Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) (i) Similar work means “Refilling / AMC / CMC of Portable Fire Extinguishers” (ii) Bidder having Registered Office in the State of Punjab and Chandigarh are eligible t o apply for this bid. Proof of the same is required to be submitted. (iii) After refilling and prior to installation, 2 or 3 fire extinguisher at random will be picked up for t esting, if any of the fire extinguisher’s performance is found unsatisfactory then the entire lot will be rejected and the contractor has to make them good. (iv) Contractor or his field staff will visit the site as and when complaint raised by the Designated Officer of the CUPB other than their monthly maintenance visit(s). On his visit he shall submit s ervice report about satisfactory working of all the fire extinguishers to the Designated Officer. (v) The contractor has to carry out a monthly maintenance and submit detailed service report for all fire extinguishers mentioned in the Scope of Work on the contractor letter head. (vi) If any damage to any cylinder and allied accessories occurred due to improper maintenance o r negligence in workmanship or during transport, the parts/spares/defective cylinder will be re placed by the contractor immediately free of cost. (vii) The contractor must submit a REFILLING WARRANTY CERTIFICATE for the refilled fire extin guishers. (viii) The cost of transportation shall be borne by the contractor. (ix) All fire extinguisher of the University are marked. The same fire extinguishers, as taken from

the University, shall be returned back. No fire extinguisher shall be replaced with any other ex tinguisher of the same capacity. Payment Terms (i) The payment will be made to CMC Service provider on quarterly basis (if the services are sati sfactory) on submission of bill by the service provider on completion of each quarter after maki ng necessary deductions, if any, as per the SLA Deductions mentioned in the GeM Contract. (ii) In case of non-delivery services, as per the prescribed service schedule (before 10 th of each month) during a month(s) of the any quarter, the payment shall be released after deduction of charges for that month(s). . 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 6.
